title: Listening Practice Test 04 – Shopping & Retail
description: Đề luyện Listening theo cấu trúc đề thi TOEIC (IIG Việt Nam), rút gọn 26 câu: Part 1 (2) · Part 2 (6) · Part 3 (9, có hội thoại 3 người, câu hỏi hàm ý và biểu đồ) · Part 4 (9). Chủ đề: mua sắm, cửa hàng, đổi trả hàng.

groups.transcript:
(A) A woman is pushing a shopping cart.
(B) A woman is stocking some shelves.
(C) Some items are being scanned at a register.
(D) The shelves are empty.

options.A: A woman is pushing a shopping cart.
options.B: A woman is stocking some shelves.
options.C: Some items are being scanned at a register.

questions.explanation: Người phụ nữ đang đẩy xe mua hàng trong lối đi → (A). Cô ấy không xếp hàng lên kệ (B – 'stock' = chất hàng lên kệ); không có quầy tính tiền (C); kệ đầy hàng (D).

groups.transcript:
(A) A vendor is weighing some fruit.
(B) Customers are filling their baskets.
(C) Fruit has been arranged in baskets.
(D) Some boxes are being unloaded from a truck.

options.A: A vendor is weighing some fruit.
options.C: Fruit has been arranged in baskets.
options.D: Some boxes are being unloaded from a truck.

questions.explanation: Trái cây đã được xếp sẵn trong các giỏ trên quầy → (C). Không có người bán/khách hàng → loại (A), (B); không có xe tải → loại (D).

groups.transcript:
Do you have this jacket in a larger size?
(A) It's larger than I thought.
(B) Let me check in the back.
(C) A leather jacket.

options.B: Let me check in the back.

questions.explanation: Khách hỏi còn cỡ lớn hơn không → nhân viên trả lời gián tiếp 'để tôi kiểm tra trong kho'. (A) lặp 'larger'; (C) lặp 'jacket'.

groups.transcript:
Where's the customer service desk?
(A) Yes, it's a great service.
(B) I'd like to return this.
(C) On the second floor, by the elevators.

options.C: On the second floor, by the elevators.

questions.explanation: Where → vị trí: tầng hai, cạnh thang máy. (A) trả lời Yes cho câu Wh-, lặp 'service'; (B) liên tưởng tới quầy dịch vụ khách hàng.

groups.transcript:
Why is the store closing early today?
(A) The staff are doing inventory.
(B) At six o'clock.
(C) Close to the station.

questions.explanation: Why → lý do: nhân viên kiểm kê hàng. (C) bẫy đồng âm 'close' (gần); (B) trả lời When.

groups.transcript:
Should I pay with cash or by credit card?
(A) A thirty-dollar refund.
(B) Yes, I paid it.
(C) Either is fine.

questions.explanation: Câu hỏi lựa chọn → 'Either is fine' (cách nào cũng được) là đáp án rất hay gặp. (B) Yes/No không hợp với câu hỏi lựa chọn.

groups.transcript:
This printer is on sale this week, isn't it?
(A) Only until Saturday.
(B) The sales department.
(C) Please print it on both sides.

options.C: Please print it on both sides.

questions.explanation: Câu hỏi đuôi xác nhận đang giảm giá → 'Chỉ đến thứ Bảy thôi' (ngầm xác nhận có). (B) bẫy 'sale' – 'sales'; (C) bẫy 'printer' – 'print'.

groups.transcript:
How often do you get new shipments of shoes?
(A) A pair of running shoes.
(B) About twice a month.
(C) By ship.

questions.explanation: How often → tần suất: khoảng hai lần mỗi tháng. (A) lặp 'shoes'; (C) bẫy âm 'shipments' – 'ship'.

groups.transcript:
W: Hi, I bought this coffee maker here last week, but it stopped working yesterday.
M: I'm sorry about that. Do you have your receipt?
W: Yes, here it is. I'd like to exchange it for a new one.
M: Unfortunately, we're out of that model right now. We're expecting more next Tuesday. Or you could choose a different model, and I'd take ten percent off.
W: I'll wait for the same model. I really like the design.
M: OK. I'll put one aside for you and give you a call when the shipment arrives.

questions.content: What problem does the woman mention?
questions.explanation: 'I bought this coffee maker… but it stopped working yesterday.' (C) sai vì cô ấy có hoá đơn.
'You could choose a different model, and I'd take ten percent off' → giảm giá cho mẫu khác.

questions.content: What will the man do when a shipment arrives?

options.A: Deliver an item to her home

questions.explanation: 'I'll… give you a call when the shipment arrives.'

groups.transcript:
W: Thanks for staying late, Ben and Carlos. Our spring sale starts tomorrow, and we need to change all the price tags tonight.
M1: No problem. How many items are on sale?
W: About three hundred. The list is on the counter.
M2: Three hundred? We only have two scanning guns.
W: Good point. I'll bring another one from the storage room. Carlos, can you print the new signs for the windows?
M2: Sure. I'll do that first.
M1: And I'll start with the electronics section.

questions.content: What is the store preparing for?
questions.explanation: 'Our spring sale starts tomorrow' – spring sale = đợt giảm giá theo mùa.

questions.content: What does one of the men imply when he says, “We only have two scanning guns”?

options.D: He would like to leave early.

questions.explanation: Câu hỏi hàm ý: 300 món hàng mà chỉ có 2 máy quét → cần thêm thiết bị. Người phụ nữ đáp 'Good point. I'll bring another one'.

questions.content: What will the woman do next?
questions.explanation: 'I'll bring another one from the storage room.' (A) là việc của Carlos.

groups.transcript:
M: Excuse me, I'm looking for a gift for my sister. She just moved into a new apartment.
W: How nice. Were you thinking of something for her kitchen? We have some beautiful dishes on sale.
M: That sounds perfect. Which floor is that on?
W: It's on the top floor. Take the elevator right behind you.
M: Thanks. Oh, and do you offer gift wrapping?
W: Yes, it's free. Just bring your item to any register, and the cashier will wrap it for you.

options.A: He is looking for a present.
options.C: He wants to return an item.
options.D: He is picking up an order.

questions.explanation: 'I'm looking for a gift for my sister' – gift = present.

questions.content: Look at the graphic. Which floor will the man most likely go to?
questions.explanation: Đồ dùng nhà bếp (dishes) ở 'the top floor' – bảng chỉ dẫn cho thấy Home & Kitchen ở tầng 4.

questions.content: What does the woman say about gift wrapping?
questions.explanation: 'Yes, it's free.' → miễn phí (free of charge).

groups.transcript: Good evening, shoppers, and thank you for choosing Maxwell's Department Store. Just a reminder that the store will close in thirty minutes, at nine p.m. Please bring your final purchases to the registers on the first floor. Also, starting tomorrow, our annual winter clearance sale begins, with up to sixty percent off selected coats, boots, and scarves. Members of our rewards program can enter the store one hour early, at nine a.m., to enjoy the best selection.

questions.content: What time does the store close tonight?
questions.explanation: 'The store will close in thirty minutes, at nine p.m.'
'Starting tomorrow, our annual winter clearance sale begins.'

questions.content: What benefit do rewards program members receive?
questions.explanation: 'Members… can enter the store one hour early' → được vào sớm.

groups.transcript: Is your old laptop slowing you down? Then visit TechZone this weekend. We're offering up to four hundred dollars in credit when you trade in your old computer for a new one. And our staff will transfer all your files to your new device for free. Trade-in offers like this don't come around often. This one ends on Sunday. TechZone has three locations in the city, and our Market Street store is open until ten p.m.

questions.explanation: Cửa hàng tặng tới $400 khi khách đổi máy tính cũ lấy máy mới → chương trình thu cũ đổi mới.

questions.content: What does the store offer to do for free?

options.D: Move data to a new device

questions.explanation: 'Our staff will transfer all your files to your new device for free' – transfer files = move data.

questions.content: What does the speaker imply when he says, “Trade-in offers like this don't come around often”?

options.A: Listeners should take advantage of the offer soon.
options.C: The offer is only for new customers.
options.D: Old devices are hard to sell.

questions.explanation: Câu hỏi hàm ý: ưu đãi hiếm có và kết thúc Chủ nhật → khuyến khích người nghe tranh thủ ngay.

groups.intro: excerpt from a meeting and chart
groups.transcript: Thanks for coming, everyone. I've put last month's sales figures on the screen. As expected, electronics had the strongest month, mainly because of the release of the new tablet. However, I'm concerned about the department with the lowest sales. It's near the back of the store, so customers have trouble finding it. Next week, we'll move it closer to the entrance. I'll need two volunteers to help with the move on Monday evening. Please let me know by Friday.

questions.content: According to the speaker, what caused strong sales in electronics?

options.B: The release of a new product

questions.explanation: '…mainly because of the release of the new tablet.'

questions.content: Look at the graphic. Which department will be moved?
questions.explanation: Bộ phận có doanh số thấp nhất sẽ được dời lên gần lối vào; theo biểu đồ, thấp nhất là Toys (22).

questions.content: What does the speaker ask for?

options.A: Volunteers to help with a task

questions.explanation: 'I'll need two volunteers to help with the move on Monday evening.'
